requirement:
After a rejection under {cite}`requirements.authoring.line_numbers.rejection`,
a submission whose `rationale` is exactly the UUID that rejection gave MUST
resolve to the rejected submission unchanged, ignoring the new submission's
other fields; acceptance remains subject to
{cite}`requirements.authoring.submission.searches.line_numbers`. After passing that gate, any other rationale that cites line numbers MUST fail
the assessment, so
an assessment rejects at most one submission. The UUID MUST NOT be recorded in
evidence.
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover each obligation of `requirements.authoring.line_numbers.resubmission`. I did not request implementation source, because the assertions are visible in the supplied test text.

**Obligations and the tests that cover them**

- **Exact UUID resolves to the rejected submission unchanged, ignoring other fields.**
  - In `src/authoring/line_numbers.rs#mod[tests]/fn[a_rejection_gives_a_uuid_that_keeps_the_rejected_submission]`, the resubmission has `determination: true`. `rejection.resubmitted(&keep)` still returns exactly `cited`, whose determination is `false`.
  - The same test checks that a UUID with a trailing space is not resolved, so only the exact string counts.
  - In `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[a_rationale_citing_line_numbers_is_rejected_once]`, the end-to-end case sends a UUID resubmission with `determination: true`. The accepted evidence keeps the original rationale.
  - In `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[search_gate_preserves_line_number_correction_and_uuid_resubmission]`, the final judgment is asserted to be `Judgment::False`.
- **Acceptance stays subject to the outstanding-search gate.**
  - In `search_gate_preserves_line_number_correction_and_uuid_resubmission`, a UUID resubmission is made while a search is outstanding. The result contains "outstanding searches".
  - The test then finishes the search and resubmits the UUID, and the submission is accepted.
  - It also shows that the gate rejection does not consume the resubmission. The second request has no "rationale set to exactly" text and a later request does. The UUID form is still offered after the gate rejection.
- **After the gate, any other rationale citing line numbers fails the assessment, so at most one submission is rejected.**
  - The `Outcome::Fail` branch of `fn[a_rejection_gives_a_uuid_that_keeps_the_rejected_submission]` is checked for "after a rejection". The end-to-end case in `fn[a_rationale_citing_line_numbers_is_rejected_once]` where a second line-number rationale is sent checks the same error text.
  - `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[a_second_line_number_rationale_fails_only_after_searches_are_finished]` shows that a second line-number rationale made with a search outstanding gets "outstanding searches", not failure. After the search is finished, it fails with "after a rejection".
  - A clean replacement rationale is accepted (case 2 of `fn[a_rationale_citing_line_numbers_is_rejected_once]` and the `decide` assertions).
- **The UUID is not recorded in evidence.** In `fn[a_rationale_citing_line_numbers_is_rejected_once]`, a regex for the UUID is asserted not to match the serialized evidence after a UUID resubmission.

**Residual points**

- Each rejection gives a fresh UUID, which the first test checks. That belongs to the `rejection` requirement and is only extra here.
- I found no obligation in the text that lacks a test, and no unacknowledged gap.

:::{req} line_numbers.rejection
When the only submission in a response under
{cite}`requirements.authoring.submission`, or a `submit_verification` call under
{cite}`requirements.authoring.verifier_prompt`, is otherwise valid but its
rationale cites line numbers under
{cite}`requirements.authoring.line_numbers.detection`, and it is the
assessment's first such submission, and it passes the outstanding-search gate
under {cite}`requirements.authoring.submission.searches.line_numbers`, the
harness MUST reject it instead of
accepting it and continue the conversation. The tool result MUST quote the
matched text, repeat the location guidance of
{cite}`requirements.authoring.judgment_rules`, and give a fresh random UUID,
saying the model may submit once more, either without line numbers or with
`rationale` set to exactly that UUID to keep the rejected submission as it was.
A rejection MUST be counted in usage like any other turn.
:::{req} submission.searches.line_numbers
After validating submission arguments or resolving the UUID resubmission
form, the outstanding-search gate MUST precede line-number rejection or
acceptance. An outstanding-search rejection MUST NOT consume the line-number
resubmission or submission reminder.
